image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel featuring a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (silver outer spokes and bright yellow inner accents). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim. The central hub contains a logo cap and visible lug nuts. Behind the spokes, a brake disc and caliper assembly are partially visible. The lighting creates strong reflections on the metallic surfaces.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow color appears slightly oversaturated and 'plastic-like' compared to the silver, lacking fine micro-scratches or realistic metallic flake texture typical of automotive paint.
Text on the tire is indistinct and smudged, which is common in AI generation but could also be depth-of-field blur. Marked as minor artifact due to lack of legibility.
The mechanical components behind the spokes (brake disc/caliper) appear somewhat fused and lack precise geometric definition, looking more like a textured blob than distinct mechanical parts.
